title: Sask. soldier killed in CFB Wainwright fire remembered as funny, passionate at military funeral
description: Pte. Shaun Farrell, 23, was one of four service members who died at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta on Oct. 17 when a grass fire spread out of control. Another 39 people were injured.
text:
Pte. Shaun Farrell, 23, was one of four service members who died at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright in Alberta on October 17 when a grass fire spread out of control. Luke Jessiman says he leaned on Shaun Farrell when basic training got tough.

And for me that person was Shaun," Jessiman said. He was speaking at the military funeral service for Pte. Farrell in Prince Albert on Wednesday.
